div.head: Lib Lond 2.1
div.ab: Si enim uim hospitandi ei in domo sua intulerit, ibique ab hospite occisus fuerit, eligat [hospes] VI de parentibus suis et iuret septimus, quia hac de causa predicta eum occiderit; sicque a nece defuncti uersus regem et parentes dominosque defuncti quietus remanebit.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 673 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

according to the Ann. Anglosax., men of Eustace of Boulogne, who was visiting Eadward III, his brother-in-law, sought at Dover in 1051 innian hi, þær heom sylfan gelicode. Ibid. Eideshelfer 6. 28 (Bateson Bor. cust. I 47; the oath of six also elsewhere, Ballard 137f.); Sippe 20; Königsfrieden 4f. 9; Königsdienst 6ff.; Mannbusse 6. 10; Wergeld 16; Totschlag 7. 8.
